whoItsFor: Mac users running Jianying (剪映) Professional 11.5.0 on Apple Silicon who want to generate editable Jianying drafts from structured plans, edit copies of multi-track projects, and export MP4 via the local engine, plus AI-agent workflows that hand off editing work.
useCases: Generate editable Jianying drafts from a structured JSON editing plan
Batch-produce drafts or hand off Agent-assisted edits without overwriting the original project
Export a verified draft snapshot to MP4 using the local Jianying engine

requirements.os: macOS 26.0+ on Apple Silicon (verified on macOS 26.5.1)
requirements.runtime: Python ≥ 3.9, FFmpeg / ffprobe, Xcode Command Line Tools, Jianying Professional 11.5.0 (or 11.4.2)
